rules.title: Think Before Coding
rules.requirement: State material assumptions and request clarification when ambiguity changes the outcome.

rules.title: Simplicity First
rules.requirement: Use the minimum implementation that satisfies the stated need.

rules.title: Surgical Changes
rules.requirement: Change only the requested surface and preserve intentional surrounding work.

rules.title: Goal-Driven Execution
rules.requirement: Translate work into verifiable goals and cite verification before completion.

rules.title: Models for Judgment Tasks Only
rules.requirement: Use deterministic logic for deterministic control decisions.

rules.title: Tests Verify Intent
rules.requirement: Design tests that fail when the intended behavior changes.

rules.title: Checkpoint After Every Significant Step
rules.requirement: After significant work, state what changed, what was verified, and what remains.

rules.title: Fail Loud
rules.requirement: Expose uncertainty and incomplete verification without presenting it as complete.

rules.title: Agent Scope Declaration
rules.requirement: Declare the permitted work scope before delegated execution.
